summary: Adversarial review covered deterministic allowlist selection, active and cleanup precedence, single-builder locking, mandate and snapshot integrity, cumulative accounting, completion reconciliation after injected process loss, deployment-target non-escalation, truthful stop classification, resume-script fidelity, unchanged non-campaign routing, and the declared documentation boundary.
